listingSettingsGroup.amazonTaxRateNote: Your price calculation automatically accounts for the estimated tax you pay when buying from Amazon. Set this rate under Store Settings → Amazon Sales Tax Rate.
listingSettingsGroup.stockBufferDescription: Your eBay quantity is Amazon's stock minus this buffer (never below 0), capped at the eBay Stock value.
